answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy, Sybil resistance is achieved through cryptoeconomic staking anchored to immutable resource consumption, functioning like a dense basalt foundation. Agents must lock collateral to participate, ensuring that spinning up fake identities incurs a prohibitive financial penalty. When verification challenges ripple across the network like an unpredictable comet, unbacked or poorly coordinated agents face rapid slashing. This economic friction binds digital sovereignty to real-world capital, dissolving fraudulent clusters into an isolated nebula of zero trust.
